Today's AI briefing from The Gradient | 2026-11-14

1. Google Search gets a major upgrade with Gemini 4 Hydrogen
Google announced that Gemini 4 Hydrogen, the latest AI model from its Gemini family, is now integrated into Google Search for all users globally.

2. Gemini Decisions API: Fast, calibrated multimodal decisions
Google introduced the Gemini Decisions API, a new developer‑facing service that uses the Gemini Decision model to produce fast, calibrated decisions across multiple modalities (text, image, video).

3. Google’s latest Search upgrade promises better answers to your most complicated questions
Google introduced an AI‑enhanced Search experience called AI Mode, built on its Gemini 4 Hydrogen model. The upgrade improves the engine’s ability to parse complex queries, surface the most relevant links, and generate richer visual responses.
